Our Story

The Instinct
to Thrive.

On an island off the coast of Belém, the parrots arrive by the thousands.

They come from hundreds of miles away - not for shelter, not for safety, but for a single, deep-purple fruit hanging from the palms. They know, without being taught, that this is what fuels them. What carries them further. What lets them thrive.

No one taught the parrots to crave açaí. They simply listen.

We believe that instinct lives in humans too. It just got quieter - buried under convenience, under the idea that healthy had to mean boring.

Pink Parrot exists on that belief: that real food - vivid, exotic, unapologetically alive - can be as thrilling as anything else worth chasing. That nourishment doesn't have to whisper. It can arrive in color, in texture, in a bowl built for the eye and the body at once.

We import the source - açaí, dragon fruit, mango, and passion fruit - straight from the soil it was born in, and shape it into something new: soft-serve without the dairy, milkshakes with a quarter of the calories, lattes layered with things your body actually wants. Every detail engineered. Every ingredient real.

This is fuel for people in motion - for the sprint, the recovery, the life that refuses to slow down. We're building Pink Parrot alongside a movement of people who play hard and eat well, not as opposites, but as one instinct.

This is just the beginning of the flock.

Our Commitment

Good for You.
Good for
the Planet.

Every superfood in your Pink Parrot bowl has a story that starts deep in the Amazon and Brazilian rainforests — and we take that responsibility seriously. The ingredients we source aren't just nutritious; they're part of a living ecosystem that depends on sustainable harvesting practices to survive.

When açaí, mango, and dragon fruit are harvested sustainably — without cutting down trees, without pesticides, with fair compensation for local harvesters — it creates an economic incentive to protect the forest rather than destroy it. Choosing Pink Parrot means choosing a bowl that gives back.

Learn About Our Superfoods
01

Sustainable Harvest

Our açaí and dragon fruit are hand-harvested using techniques that leave trees intact — preserving the forest and the livelihoods of local communities.

02

Biodiversity

Sustainable açaí harvesting preserves a portion of the fruit for wildlife — supporting the animals that disperse seeds and naturally replant the forest.

03

Community Value

Every bowl supports the Amazonian harvesters and Brazilian farming families who have cultivated these fruits for generations — fairly and with deep respect.

04

No Pesticides

The superfoods we serve are grown using only natural resources — no synthetic fertilizers, no pesticides. Real ingredients, as nature intended them.
